baseline_action: do not replay repaired candidates; keep v20.35 as static pre-replay supply
counterfactual_action: build replay adapter and run strict-implies-compile replay over v20.35 repaired candidates

effort_calibration.agent_instruction: Use this prior as a baseline when estimating effort; override only by naming why this contract differs structurally.

positive: May convert repaired public-adapter supply into compile-backed labels for future union training

horizon: one adapter plus local Lean replay over 20 v20.35 repaired candidates
objective_resolver: Success iff a v20.37 replay artifact exists and reports attempted_candidate_rows >= 20, compiled_candidate_actions >= 1, new_strict_same_target_rows >= 1, harmful_compiled_mismatch_actions == 0, source-policy flags clean, train_gnn_now=false, and gnn_blocked=true. question: Will replay of the v20.35 source-aligned repaired candidates add at least one compile-backed same-target strict row without harmful mismatches?
void_conditions: v20.35 or v20.36 missing, adapter cannot preserve source-policy fields, or replay bridge cannot hydrate candidate rows
